generation.mode: built-in imagegen edit with edit target first and canon second as reference only

lightingIsotropy.metric: 36-bin land-luminance-gradient magnitude peak divided by uniform-bin mean; water-mask pixels and gradients below 12 luminance units excluded
lightingIsotropy.visualCheck: No long cast-shadow field or time-of-day gradient is visible, but many boulders and stacks retain brighter upper facets and darker side faces. The literal same-value-on-every-side requirement is not met.

buildableVsSteepFraction.basis: manual estimate of non-water land area
buildableVsSteepFraction.method: Open grass lanes and coherent moor shelf count as buildable; cliff and stack faces count as steep; the boulder maze, scrub, shingle, talus, and broken rock make up the remainder.

waterMask.encoding: opaque white water pixels on fully transparent non-water pixels; binary alpha
waterMask.derivation: Source-raster colour classification connected to the sea, with the two visible narrow beck courses traced at source resolution; emergent stack and shore rock remain transparent.
waterMask.visualCheck: The mask covers open water, surf, wash, ripple highlights, reflections, and both becks. Transparent interiors inside the connected sea component are the five sea-stack bodies and emergent rocks, not unclassified water.

crown.method: Measured all identified full conifer crown components on the 1254 px source, including saplings, then scaled widths by 2560/1254; median source width 30.5 px.

openRisks: Hard lighting failure: repeated bright upper facets and darker side faces remain on rocks and stacks despite the low aggregate whole-cell key-light asymmetry.
The central field is dense and maze-like, but most boulders read smaller and more uniform than the required 4-7 m house-sized erratics.
Several stacks read as similarly proportioned basalt towers; owner review should judge whether the requested ordinary weathered irregularity is sufficient.
Visual seam continuity, exact water-edge judgment, scale, and terrain quality remain director and owner decisions; this report does not claim visual acceptance.
